Headline: Closure - Leweston School, Dorset
Info: Leweston School, a Catholic independent boarding and day school, has announced its permanent and immediate closure during the October half-term due to severe financial pressures exacerbated by falling pupil numbers and the introduction of VAT on fees. All pupils have been offered alternative places at schools within the Inspired Learning Group.

Headline: Closure - Bilsdale Midcable Chopgate Church of England Primary (State), North Yorkshire
Info: Bilsdale Midcable Chopgate Church of England Primary School is facing potential closure after its pupil numbers fell to just eight, with only four children expected to remain on the roll by next September.

Headline: Closure - La Sainte Union Catholic Secondary School (State), London
Info: Camden Council has launched a public consultation regarding the potential closure of four faith schools, including La Sainte Union, driven by falling pupil numbers, housing pressures, and financial difficulties.

Headline: Restructuring - Cheltenham College, Gloucestershire
Info: Cheltenham College has announced a major overhaul of its boarding options, introducing five new day and boarding pathways from September 2027 to offer greater choice and flexibility to modern families.
